markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Reflexive Courage](/Feats.aspx?ID=4608) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Auditory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=16" />
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 105

**Prerequisites**
[warrior muse](/Muses.aspx?ID=4)

**Trigger**
A creature within your reach uses an auditory effect, manipulate action, or move action; makes a ranged attack; or leaves a square during its move action

**Requirements**
You are affected by courageous anthem

</column>

---

You bellow a ferocious call to arms, inspiring yourself to lash out at a foe. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the action is disrupted.
name: Reflexive Courage
requirement: You are affected by courageous anthem
